metadata.name: Level Trading - Single WHALE Analyzer (DEBUG)
metadata.description: Single analyzer test to verify whale detection logic. Entry threshold lowered to 40% to allow more signal participation.
metadata.author: Edison Trading Bot

WHALE_ANALYZER_NEW._minCandlesForWhale_comment: Minimum candles needed for whale detection (default: 25, range: 10-50)
WHALE_ANALYZER_NEW._baseConfidence_comment: Base confidence when whale detected (default: 0.1, range: 0.05-0.3)
WHALE_ANALYZER_NEW._strengthMultiplier_comment: Strength multiplier for confidence calculation (default: 0.85, range: 0.5-1.0)
WHALE_ANALYZER_NEW._recentCandlesWindow_comment: Number of recent candles to analyze for volume spikes (default: 30, range: 10-100)
WHALE_ANALYZER_NEW._volumeThresholdMultiplier_comment: Volume spike threshold (volume > avg * multiplier) (default: 3, range: 1.5-5.0)
